pages.title: Stickman Dismount Simulator
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Set up a crash in Stickman Dismount Simulator and send the stickman into barriers and traps. Use turbo to add speed and watch how the impact throws him through the course. The goal is to rack up damage, so try a different approach if your first crash leaves too much of the course untouched.

pages.title: Stacking Match
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Pull colored blocks out of a layered tower in Stacking Match. Each block goes to a matching box, and a set of three clears the box so another can take its place. Check the colors the current boxes need before choosing which block to take from the tower.

pages.title: Emoji Frenzy
pages.creator: ArKeny
pages.description: Read the word on screen in Emoji Frenzy and tap the emoji that matches it. Consecutive correct answers build a streak and earn more points, but a mistake ends the run. Each round gives you less time to react, and you can unlock new themes as you play.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Island
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Search illustrated locations in Hidden Objects Island for the items the puzzle asks you to find. Scan each scene in sections, paying attention to objects tucked among other details. Finding the requested objects lets you continue the island adventure and explore another location.

pages.title: Earth Defender
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Protect the planet with an orbiting ship in Earth Defender. Tap to reverse the direction of orbit and steer into meteors before they strike Earth. Watch where each meteor is approaching from and decide whether to stay on course or turn back to intercept it.

pages.title: Penguin Farm - Ice Merge
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Build a settlement on frozen islands in Penguin Farm - Ice Merge. Gather resources, merge wood, and use what you produce to build or upgrade farm buildings. Train penguins to improve production and expand into new territory. Keep an eye on the ocean for drifting treasure chests.

pages.title: Emoji Drop Themes
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Drop items into a container in Emoji Drop Themes. When identical pieces touch, they merge into a bigger piece, which can start another merge nearby. Choose where to drop emojis, fruit, or animals so the pile has room to grow. Try Adventure or Classic mode and see how far you can take a merge chain.

pages.title: Meme Wars
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build a lineup of meme-inspired fighters in Meme Wars. Spend coins to summon units and drag identical ones together to merge them. Decide where melee and ranged fighters should stand before battle, then adjust your lineup as each stage brings in different enemies.

pages.title: Tropical Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Join Coco for a tropical match-three game in Tropical Match 2. Line up fruits and flowers to work through the board goals, including clearing obstacles such as algae and clouds. Follow the island levels or take on daily missions as you search for treasures.

pages.title: Toca Avatar My Hospital
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Run a medical center in Toca Avatar My Hospital. Choose characters and drag them into consultation rooms, then use the equipment to examine patients and find out what needs treatment. Move between rooms to handle different patients and see what each part of the hospital can do.

pages.title: Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear the layered layout in Mahjong Classic by removing pairs of identical tiles. Look for exposed tiles on the edges first, since blocked pieces cannot be picked. A good pair can uncover a tile you need later, so consider what each match opens up as you work through the layout.

pages.title: Flight Sim Air Traffic control
pages.creator: Raid games
pages.description: Draw flight paths for planes and helicopters in Flight Sim Air Traffic control. Guide each aircraft to its landing area and check where other routes cross before you commit to a path. Keep the aircraft from colliding as you bring in more traffic and work through the levels.

pages.title: Shoot Run Monster Hunting
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run through obstacle courses in Shoot Run Monster Hunting. Gather pickups as you move and bring your weapon to bear when monsters cross your path. Each setting changes the route, so watch for the next obstacle while keeping track of what you need to shoot.

pages.title: Strykon
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Strykon is a first-person shooter with missions and modes such as Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All. Pick a weapon that suits the fight, from a pistol or shotgun to a rifle for longer shots. Move between cover, reload between encounters, and earn rewards through the Battle Pass.

pages.title: Color It in 3D
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Paint a collection of figures in Color It in 3D. Choose a model, then press and swipe to color the surface. Rotate the figure to reach the far side or zoom in to work on small details. Finished cartoon, fantasy, and anime-style figures go into your collection.

pages.title: Sprunki 3D Shooter
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fight waves of Sprunkies in Sprunki 3D Shooter. Move around the battlefield with WASD and use the left mouse button to fire. Watch how much ammunition you have left, and look for rounds scattered around the field when you need to keep shooting through the next wave.

pages.title: Mine FPS shooter: Noob Arena
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fight waves of enemies in Mine FPS shooter: Noob Arena. Equip weapons and armor for a run through three blocky arenas, then prepare for the boss battle. Seven weapons give you different options when enemies crowd the arena. Keep moving and give yourself time to reload between attacks.

pages.title: Bubble Merge 2048
pages.creator: Supercode Games
pages.description: Aim and fire numbered bubbles in Bubble Merge 2048. Hit a matching bubble to merge them into a higher number and work toward the level target. Barrels and boxes can block your shots, so break through them when they cut off the part of the board you need.

pages.title: Spaceflight Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Build and launch a rocket in Spaceflight Simulator. Decide how to assemble the spacecraft before attempting liftoff, then see how your design handles the flight. If the rocket falls short, change the setup and try again to see what gets it farther.

pages.title: Pirates Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Look for pairs of pirate-themed tiles in Pirates Mahjong. Choose two matching pieces to remove them from the layout, then check which tiles the move has uncovered. Work through the board a pair at a time until you can clear the last pieces.

pages.title: Jump Up 3D: Basketball Game
pages.creator: Traxnet OÜ
pages.description: Take your basketball shots from a trampoline in Jump Up 3D: Basketball Game. Watch your player rise and time the release so the ball goes through the hoop. You are racing an opponent to score, so settle into the rhythm of the bounce before the next shot.

pages.title: Zombie Rodeo Multiplication
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Solve multiplication problems to keep your zombie in one piece in Zombie Rodeo Multiplication. A wrong answer or an expired timer costs the rider a body part. Pick from four difficulty settings, then see how long you can stay in the rodeo and earn coins for upgrades.

pages.title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Take a sports car over ramps in Real Cars Epic Stunts and race the clock to finish the course. Crashes can damage the car, so think about how you will land before leaving a ramp. Collect coins and diamonds for new cars or upgrades, and try the tracks alone or with another player.

pages.title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
pages.creator: RBIN
pages.description: Dribble past the opposing team in 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport and get the ball to the hoop. Use WASD, the arrow keys, or a mouse drag to move on the court. Change direction to get past defenders and look for a clear approach to score in these offline games.

pages.title: Merge Thirteen
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Drag through three or more neighboring tiles of the same number in Merge Thirteen. A completed chain leaves a tile one number higher where you ended the drag. Choose that last tile carefully so it can join a later chain, and keep building toward thirteen. A joker can link with any number.

pages.title: Favorite Puzzles
pages.creator: RAD BROTHERS
pages.description: Choose an image from the gallery or use your own photo in Favorite Puzzles. Set the piece count from six to 600, then assemble the picture at a difficulty that suits you. Turn on a guide image or a grid when you need help finding where a piece belongs.

pages.title: Speed Typing Test
pages.creator: Zhivotech
pages.description: Type the words that appear in Speed Typing Test before the clock runs out. Keep your spelling accurate while you try to increase your pace. Compare your result with earlier attempts and see whether you can type more words correctly on the next run.

pages.title: Squid Run
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description: Escape the guards in Squid Run by jumping over the traps along the route. Click when you need to clear thorns or get past poison, and watch where you will land before committing to the next jump. See how far you can get without being caught.

pages.title: Physics Puzzle
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Guide a ball into a basket in Physics Puzzle. Use the objects you are given to build a path around the obstacles, then watch where the ball goes. Adjust the arrangement if it rolls or falls away from the basket before reaching the end.

pages.title: BALANCE TOWER
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Drop blocks onto a growing skyscraper in BALANCE TOWER. Line up each drop carefully so the weight stays balanced as you build higher. Some stages set a target for you to reach, while others let you keep stacking until the tower topples.

pages.title: Stickman Zombie Escape
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Help a stickman escape a dungeon in Stickman Zombie Escape. Jump between blocks and keep clear of spikes and arrows fired by zombies. Read the hints as you work through the rooms and reach the castle to complete the level.

pages.title: Offroad Masters Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive trucks across rough terrain in Offroad Masters Challenge. Work through a career, explore in Free Drive, or head to the crash arena when you want to test a truck in collisions. Change the engine or tires to suit the terrain, and play alone or with a second driver.

pages.title: 2020 Plus
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Place three pieces at a time on the grid in 2020 Plus. A complete row or column disappears and adds to your score, leaving space for later shapes. Use all three pieces to get the next set, and try to leave enough room for blocks that are harder to fit.

pages.title: Human Evolution Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Lead a crowd through an obstacle course in Human Evolution Rush. Steer toward companions and gates that help your group grow or move through different years. Keep the crowd away from hazards, then use the group you have built to defeat the enemies at the finish.

pages.title: Pop It Fidget 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Press bubbles on a set of 3D shapes in Pop It Fidget 3D. Choose one of three patterns and work your way across it until all the bubbles are pressed. The shape flips over when you finish, giving you a fresh side to pop.

pages.title: Monsters Merge
pages.creator: Tufty Fluff
pages.description: Turn a ruined farm into a monster attraction in Monsters Merge. Combine identical creatures to discover different ones, and buy monsters or wait for them to appear at the portal. Invest in upgrades as you build a collection that can draw more visitors.

pages.title: Penalty Champs 22
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Pick a national team and take it into a shootout in Penalty Champs 22. Set the direction, height, and power of each shot, then choose where to send the keeper when the other side takes its penalty. Play the championship with or without the group stage, or challenge a friend over Wi-Fi.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Horses Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Piece together photos of ponies, stallions, and other horses in Jigsaw Puzzle Horses Edition. Choose from 49 pictures and use details such as a horse's outline or markings to find pieces that belong together. Work on a small section at a time until the full photo comes into view.

pages.title: Pop Ball
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Tap to create white balls in Pop Ball. They destroy the colored balls they collide with, so choose where to spawn them based on where the targets are moving. Clear every colored ball from the board before moving on to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Julies Spring Fashion
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Put together a seasonal look for Julie in Julies Spring Fashion. Try different clothing and styling choices as you get her ready for the royal encounter in the story. Compare how the pieces look together before settling on an outfit for her.

pages.title: Pic Pie Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Put a round photo back together in Pic Pie Puzzles. Swipe across two neighboring wedges to swap their positions. Use colors and lines that cross the slice edges to figure out what should go next to what, then keep swapping until the picture is restored.

pages.title: 2 Player Moto Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race motorcycles on tracks in space in 2 Player Moto Racing. Use the split-screen mode to take on a second rider as you steer around the course. Save nitro for a stretch where you have room to accelerate, and reset the bike if you get stuck.

pages.title: BallBlaster
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Move a cannon to intercept incoming rocks in BallBlaster. Keep firing while you track where the next target is headed, and move when the current position leaves you in its path. Try to keep the cannon in action long enough to beat your previous survival time.

pages.title: Dangerous Roads
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep a hot dog car on the winding track in Dangerous Roads. Take tight curves without driving off the edge and adjust when wind or storms make the road harder to follow. Watch for slippery stretches as the environment changes around the car.

pages.title: ArchHero Viking Story
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Clear an island of enemies in ArchHero Viking Story, then sail to the next fight. The battles get harder as you progress, but you can pick one of three bonuses when you level up. Choose an upgrade that will help your Viking against the enemies still ahead.

pages.title: Matching Santa
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Trace a chain through at least three identical Santas in Matching Santa. There are four designs to tell apart and a timer running beside the board. Connect six or more of the same Santa in one move to earn extra time and keep the round going.

pages.title: 2022 Dark Academia to eGirl Dress Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Create two looks in 2022 Dark Academia to eGirl Dress Up. Style the Dark Academia student with warm tones and subtle makeup, then switch to the eGirl wardrobe for a bolder look. Try different expressions on the eGirl character to see how they change the effect of the outfit.

pages.title: Sisters Together Forever
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Style Eliza and Anna in Sisters Together Forever. Choose outfits for the sisters and give each a look of her own, or select pieces that complement each other. The dress-up game follows the two characters and their relationship as sisters.

pages.title: Jumpy Sky
pages.creator: PKPL Entertainment
pages.description: Keep a ball climbing in Jumpy Sky by sliding it left and right. Watch the platforms above you so you can guide the next bounce toward a landing. Pick up coins on the way and use them to unlock different characters as you try to climb higher.

pages.title: Stickman Warfield
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lead a stickman army in Stickman Warfield and try to seize the enemy flag. Position your troops for each clash and use them to stop the forces moving into your territory. Push forward once you have cleared a route toward the flag.

pages.title: Stupid Chicken
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Help a chicken find enough to eat in Stupid Chicken. Tap to peck at food offered by the farmer or catch insects nearby. After eating, the chicken can lay an egg. Gather as many eggs as you can against the clock, then trade them for more play time.

pages.title: Lady Tower
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Build a tower of people in Lady Tower. Tap to jump onto the men you meet along the route and add them to the stack. Keep building the tower as you move through the level so the rider can reach the boy waiting above.

pages.title: Chef Knife Master
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Chop ingredients quickly in Chef Knife Master. Tap or click to bring the knife down on bananas, carrots, peppers, potatoes, and other food. Pay attention to the task for the current round while you work through the ingredients and try to raise your score.

pages.title: Mineblock Rotate and Fly Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Help Steve get home across rotating platforms in Mineblock Rotate and Fly Adventure. Wait for the platform to point toward a safe landing before you tap to jump. Watch for obstacles between platforms and time your way through all seven levels.

pages.title: Xtreme Bottle Shoot
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up shots at glass bottles in Xtreme Bottle Shoot. Move the aim onto a bottle before firing and check the next target once it breaks. Try different settings and switch between bullets and stones to see how each handles the targets.

pages.title: Baby Taylor Hand Care
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Taylor's mom care for Taylor's hands in Baby Taylor Hand Care. A trip to the park left Taylor with dirty hands and broken nails after building sandcastles. Follow the hand-spa routine to clean her hands and tidy her nails.

pages.title: My Sisters Perfect Wedding
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Elsa prepare Anna for her wedding in My Sisters Perfect Wedding. Choose Anna's bridal clothes, makeup, and hairstyle, then put together a bridesmaid outfit for Elsa. Style them separately so each look suits the role the sister has in the ceremony.

pages.title: Alphabet Memory Game
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Hear how English letters are pronounced in the Learning mode of Alphabet Memory Game. Select a letter to hear it, then try the card-matching activity on Easy, Normal, or Hard. Turn over cards and remember where each letter appeared so you can find all the pairs.

pages.title: Ice Princess Wedding Day
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Plan a winter wedding in Ice Princess Wedding Day. Choose a gown for the bride and decorate the hall, including the arch and aisle. Match the details to the icy setting, then see the prince and princess together for the celebration and dance.

pages.title: Extreme City GT Car Stunts
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Drive a GT car along tight stunt courses in Extreme City GT Car Stunts. Use the arrow keys to steer through turns and keep the car on the track. Judge the next curve before building up speed, since the route is part of the stunt.

pages.title: Princess Cheongsam Shanghai Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style Anna and Elsa in Princess Cheongsam Shanghai Fashion. Choose colors and outfits from looks inspired by Qing-era clothing and modern qipao styles. Try a high-slit cut or a shorter dress, then compare how the two princesses wear their choices.

pages.title: Pop The Shit
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Tap the piles as they appear in Pop The Shit. Move from one target to the next and try to pop them quickly with the game's single tap control. Keep scanning the play area so you can react when another target shows up.

pages.title: Whack A Mole
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Whack A Mole starts you off with 15 seconds to hit as many moles as you can. Aim for the hard hats when you need more time and the magicians when you want extra points. Leave the bombs alone, and play well enough to bring out the boss mole.

pages.title: Against Coronavirus Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble three coronavirus-awareness pictures in Against Coronavirus Slide. Choose an image and one of the three puzzle modes, then slide the tiles back into place. Look for details that carry across tile edges to tell which parts of the picture should meet.

pages.title: Crepes
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Follow the kitchen instructions in Crepes to make thin pancakes. Work with the ingredients as the recipe takes you through the preparation. The dish can take sweet or savory fillings, from a simple sugar topping to a more elaborate version such as crêpes Suzette.

pages.title: Scary Reptiles Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Pick one of eight reptile pictures in Scary Reptiles Coloring. Fill the drawing with colors from a palette of 23 and work quickly if you want to earn a higher score. When you have finished, save the colored picture to keep your version.

pages.title: Fast Driver
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Steer through traffic in Fast Driver and keep the racing car clear of other vehicles. Click or tap to move left or right as the road gets busier at higher speeds. The third collision ends the run, so watch for a gap before you move across traffic.

pages.title: Kings Rush
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Defend your kingdom in Kings Rush using warriors and mages. Send your forces against attacking orcs, trolls, and evil wizards as the fighting reaches your realm. Think about which defenders to use as the makeup of the opposing forces changes.

pages.title: City Defender
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Aim a tank at bombs drifting down on parachutes in City Defender. Fire before they reach the city, then move your aim to the next target. Watch which bombs are closest to the ground so you can deal with the most urgent threat first.

pages.title: Tank Strategy
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Prepare for each mission in Tank Strategy by buying tanks and fuel. Choose where to position your vehicles before sending them against the enemy. Think about how you want the attack to unfold before spending your supplies, since the setup shapes the fight.

pages.title: Impossible Bike Stunts Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Ride through motorcycle stunt challenges in Impossible Bike Stunts Racing Game. Keep the bike on the course as you take on the obstacles and adjust your speed before awkward stretches. Each challenge asks you to balance control of the bike with getting through the route.

pages.title: 8 Ball Billiard Pool
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take on a computer opponent in 8 Ball Billiard Pool. Aim with the mouse and choose a shot that leaves the cue ball somewhere useful for your next turn. Work through your group of balls before taking a shot at the eight.

pages.title: Brain Memory
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Remember where the orange symbols appear in Brain Memory. Once the preview ends, select the positions you saw. Work quickly and check the layout before it disappears, then see how far you can make it through the game's 30 memory tests.

pages.title: 2020 Triumph Rocket Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put a Triumph Rocket motorcycle picture back together in 2020 Triumph Rocket Slide. Choose one of three photos and a puzzle mode, then slide the pieces into the right arrangement. Look for details on the wheels and bodywork that tell you where neighboring tiles fit.

pages.title: Super Stickman Sling
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Swing past obstacles in Super Stickman Sling. Tap to hook onto a point and use the swing to send the stickman onward. Watch the arc and choose when to let go so you can clear what is ahead and reach the next hook.

pages.title: Ice Queen Home Recovery
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Take care of the Ice Queen as she recovers at home in Ice Queen Home Recovery. Treat her wounds and fractures, check her temperature and pulse, and help her pass the time. Put on her favorite music or make a smoothie while she rests.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Pick from twelve truck pictures in Crazy Monster Truck Jigsaw. Assemble your chosen image with 25, 49, or 100 pieces, depending on the difficulty you want. Use details such as tires and body panels to find pieces that join when the colors are similar.

pages.title: Chicken Road
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Get chickens across the road in Chicken Road. Tap to make them walk or stop, and swipe to make a chicken run when it needs to get through quickly. Keep watching the approaching vehicles while you decide whether to wait or cross.

pages.title: Ludo Online
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Race four tokens to the middle in Ludo Online. Roll the die and choose which token to move on each turn. Practice against a computer opponent, join a match with other players, or share a private code to bring friends into the same game.

pages.title: Push Block
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Push a group of blocks toward the goal in Push Block. Slide to steer around obstacles while moving the blocks with you. Look at how wide the group is before entering a gap so you can bring more of the blocks through to the destination.

pages.title: Ferrari Super Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to reconstruct photos of Ferraris in Ferrari Super Cars Slide. Choose one of three images and a puzzle mode, then work the shuffled pieces into place. Follow details such as a hood line or the edge of a wheel to see which parts belong together.

pages.title: Zombies Night
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Defend the city in Zombies Night, a first-person shooter set after dark. Aim and shoot with the mouse, reload with R, and throw grenades with G. Switch between weapons with the number keys as zombies approach and keep firing until the threat is cleared.

pages.title: Halloween Dark Night
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Click pumpkins to score in Halloween Dark Night before the timer runs out. Hit bats and ghosts when they appear for extra points, but avoid the TNT. A click on the explosive costs 5,000 points, so check the target before you try to squeeze in another hit.

pages.title: King of Drag
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Race a rival in King of Drag and time your gear changes as the engine revs build. A well-timed shift helps you keep accelerating along the straight track. Try the game's ten supercars and work through five levels to win the cups.

pages.title: Stick World
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Collect as much cash as you can in Stick World. Move with the arrow keys and fight other stickmen with Space as you try to raise your total. The leaderboard tracks cash, so keep an eye on chances to collect more while fights are going on.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Brushing Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Guide Baby Hazel through her morning routine in Baby Hazel Brushing Time. Show her which tools to use as she brushes her teeth, massages her gums, and cleans her tongue. Stay with her as she learns to do each step in order.

pages.title: Jumpy
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Guide the jumping character left or right in Jumpy fun. Drag to adjust its horizontal position while it is in the air, and watch where it will come down before you move again. See how long you can keep the jumps going.

pages.title: Alpha Space Invasion
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fly into an invaded sector in Alpha Space Invasion. Destroy enemy spacecraft and steer around asteroids while trying to keep your shields up. An interactive tutorial introduces the controls before you take on the endless fight and try to land as many hits as you can.

pages.title: Eggy Car
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Drive over hills with an egg balanced on your car in Eggy Car. Ease over crests and control your speed on descents so the egg stays on top. Try to cover more distance on each run without losing your cargo.

pages.title: Las Vegas Blackjack
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play a round of cards in Las Vegas Blackjack and try to beat the dealer. Take another card if you need a higher total or stand when you want to keep your hand. Get as close to 21 as you can without going over.

pages.title: Jump 111
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hold the left mouse button to flip in Jump 111. Judge how much rotation you have time for before the landing, then bring the jumper down safely. The challenge is to complete a full turn while you are still in the air.

pages.title: Perfect Hit
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Gather balls along the route in Perfect Hit and guide them into the hole. Steer around obstacles when you are vulnerable and use the invincible stretches to get through safely. Keep as many balls with you as possible when the path narrows toward the goal.

pages.title: Super Rocket
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Pilot a rocket through space in Super Rocket. Pick up numbers and use them to break through blocks while keeping clear of incoming meteor rocks. Watch the gaps ahead before deciding whether to collect another number or move out of danger.

pages.title: Floral Realife Manicure
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Start with hand spa treatments in Floral Realife Manicure, then shape the nails and choose a polish. Add patterns or glitter to finish the manicure. Try different designs from nail to nail or repeat a floral look across the set.

pages.title: Nerdy Girl Fat to Fit
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Help the main character through a makeover in Nerdy Girl Fat to Fit. Guide her through a gym session, apply spa treatments, and choose a new outfit from the dressing area. The three activities let you work through the makeover one stage at a time.

pages.title: Professor Bubble
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Aim the launcher in Professor Bubble and send bubbles toward ones of the same color. Build a group big enough to pop and clear space for the next shot. Watch the colors across the board and look for an opening that reaches a useful cluster.

pages.title: Princesses Sporty & Funky Day
pages.creator: Natalia Yarovenko
pages.description: Join the princesses for a workout and a makeover in Princesses Sporty & Funky Day. Work through the exercise activity, then pick clothes and accessories for the dress-up stage. The day also includes a graffiti activity, where you can switch from putting together outfits to working with paint.

pages.title: Highschool Divas
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Put together three looks in Highschool Divas. Match a top with a skirt or pants, choose shoes that go with the colors, and try a hairstyle that complements the outfit. Work on each girl separately so the three designs can have their own styles.

pages.title: Sofia vs Amber Fashion Contest
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Style Sofia and Amber for their family fashion contest in Sofia vs Amber Fashion Contest. Prepare each princess separately before she appears before King Roland, Queen Miranda, and Prince James. See how the jury scores the two looks and pick your own favorite.

pages.title: Hero Ellie Villain Defeat
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Choose a mission outfit in Hero Ellie Villain Defeat. Try superhero suits, boots, and hairstyles on Ellie, then select a superpower for her to take into the fight. Put together the look and ability you want before she goes after the town's most wanted villain.
